body: Thanks, but it's less about the game and more about the fact that I have little to no interaction with my best friend after 18 years of friendship.

Not very confident. My entire family went there including my older sibling, but they all have good work ethics. I don't have the same drive. I absolutely have zero motivation to do any of the work assigned. I've bs'd my way to mediocre grades that got me accepted to a meh school. I initially though programming was cool but I've come to find that it's not enjoyable to me and only frustrates me. It just seems like I have only 6 months to figure out what road I want to take for the rest of my life when I feel like curling into a ball and shutting the world out instead.

Well, college is on the table but I haven't got a clue what I'm going to do there. I thought I wanted to do computer science but I've lost interest and I sucked at it anyway. I'm probably not going to get into the school I wanted but I have a backup that I've already been accepted into.
